question.en: What will you actually carry to take the photo?
question.zh-cn: 要拍这张照片，你实际得带上什么？

summary.en: Compare a compact zoom, a bridge-style long zoom, and an interchangeable-lens kit by packed size, framing range, and shooting task.
summary.zh-cn: 从装包体积、取景范围和拍摄任务出发，对照便携变焦、一体式长变焦和可换镜头套装。

boundary.en: Product names describe design or use, while image quality depends on the capture conditions and the equipment. Nikon lists the P950 under Compact Digital Cameras and also calls it a bridge camera. Use the actual dimensions to judge whether it fits your bag.
boundary.zh-cn: 产品名称描述设计或用途，成像表现还要看设备与拍摄条件。尼康将 P950 列在「小型数码相机」中，也称它为桥式相机。要判断能否装进包，直接核对尺寸。

en: Start with the setup you would carry. Check the space it takes with the lens attached, and include the battery, card, and any extras you would pack.

Decide how you need to change framing. An integrated zoom changes the field of view with the same lens. An interchangeable-lens body can take another compatible lens, so the range and carry size depend on the lens you choose.

Work backward from the shot. A street scene might need a wide view. A distant subject might need a tight view from the same spot. The 35 mm equivalent focal-length range helps you compare framing across these examples.
zh-cn: 先看实际携带的组合。量装好镜头后的体积，算上电池、存储卡和打算放进包里的配件。
再想取景要怎么变化。一体式变焦用同一支镜头改变视角。可换镜头机身能换装兼容镜头，取景范围和携带体积随镜头组合而变。
最后从要拍的照片倒推。街景可能需要宽视角，远处的主体可能需要从同一位置取更窄的画面。用 35 mm 等效焦距范围可以比较这些组合的取景范围。
